page.overview:
Who is Cavandra?

Tylin comments that "Aes Sedai never tell a word more than they absolutely must", marking Elayne Trakand and Nynaeve al'Meara as exceptions to that rule. Surprisingly, she also says that she could also talk with Cavandra in the same way, indicating a more relaxed relationship between ruler and advisor.

Cavandra has a One Power strength of , making her weak for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to Travel without linking with another sister.

She was Tylin Quintara Mitsobar's advisor before leaving her to go back to the White Tower after the new Amyrlin Elaida summoned her. Cavandra had been advisor also to Tylin's father when he was king of Altara.

The Companion says she "had limited influence, since she had been advisor to a minor throne for so long". It's unclear if this means that her influence was less because the throne was minor, or it was greater because of her longevity in the position.
